title: Apple's Siri AI Can Be Swapped Out for Claude, ChatGPT, Code Shows
summary: Code discovered in iOS 18 reveals that Apple has built-in infrastructure allowing users to swap Siri with other AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT, suggesting Apple is opening up its AI ecosystem for third-party integration.
problem_solved: Addresses user demand for flexibility to use preferred AI assistants instead of being locked into Siri on Apple devices.
why_valuable: This represents a significant shift in Apple's traditionally closed ecosystem, giving users choice while enabling competition between AI providers on iOS.
